answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital as a stake to gain voting power. Like a karst landscape carved by persistent flow, the network distributes influence based on wealth rather than node count. This creates a marble-solid defense where an attacker incurs the extreme cost of acquiring a majority of supply, refracting their influence through a prism of economic sacrifice that renders malicious replication prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
